scope.mode: static local source audit; no Unity invocation or runtime reflection
scope.coverage: All concrete AbstractMaterialNode descendants in requested node roots, plus native external node families discovered by SearchWindowProvider: provider models, CRT, SubGraphOutput, core particle functions and shipped non-sample SpeedTree subgraphs. All primary source files are accounted for.
not_enumerable_statically: Project/user/imported sample subgraph assets and external reflected-function providers are open-ended; retain native dynamic discovery.
Active runtime package defines, loaded provider registry, material target/options and platform shader compilation were not evaluated.

architecture.approach: Native Shader Graph graph/model/node validation and codegen via an Editor assembly-reference adapter; all native behaviors remain owned by Unity.
architecture.whimtex_mapping_purpose: Migration/UX comparison only. Matching names or operation families do not imply compatible algorithms, port contracts or native serialization.

schema_notes.literal_title: Last resolved TitleAttribute string only; null when absent. Provider/asset labels are represented separately. Class names and file names are never used as invented titles.
schema_notes.visibility: A TitleAttribute is not proof that a node appears in Create Node. Dynamic blackboard/asset entries, hidden deprecated nodes and untitled infrastructure are explicit.
schema_notes.stages: Both means no explicit intrinsic slot restriction in the inspected class; upstream graph dependencies, generated HLSL and target/pass restrictions still apply. Slot evidence is literal source, not runtime-generated port schema.
schema_notes.urp_availability: Union of URP material contexts, not a promise that every node works in every URP subtarget. Separate CRT target is usable alongside URP but not UniversalTarget.
